definitions.explanation: The official or formal name of an organization, product, place, or concept. More formal than {名前|なまえ} and typically refers to the established name of something rather than a person's name.

examples.japanese: {正式|せいしき}{名称|めいしょう}は{何|なん}ですか。
{駅|えき}の{名称|めいしょう}が{変更|へんこう}された。
この{法律|ほうりつ}の{正式|せいしき}{名称|めいしょう}は{長|なが}すぎて{覚|おぼ}えにくい。
examples.english: The formal name of this law is too long to remember easily.

notes:
USAGE:
Used for the official names of organizations, places, products, and laws — not for personal names. More formal than {名前|なまえ}, which can refer to any kind of name including personal names.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {正式|せいしき}{名称|めいしょう}: official/formal name
- {名称|めいしょう}{変更|へんこう}: name change
- {名称|めいしょう}を{定|さだ}める: to establish a name
- {商品|しょうひん}{名称|めいしょう}: product name
